description: A utility object for string manipulation, providing join and split methods that operate on a custom LinkedList class and delegate to external utility objects JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string join and split utilities.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins the elements of a LinkedList into a single String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList of substrings using SplitUtils.
